definitions.gloss: silently; quietly and steadily; diligently without complaint
definitions.explanation: Working or doing something in silence, with steady focus and without complaining or chatting. Implies dedication and perseverance.

examples.japanese: {黙々|もくもく}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{働|はたら}いた→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{黙々|もくもく}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{食|た}べ→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧た。

⟦{職人|しょくにん}→職人：09868_shokunin⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{黙々|もくもく}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧、⟦{夕方|ゆうがた}→夕方：01010_yuugata⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{全|すべ}て→全て：03822_subete⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}→注文：03485_chuumon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{仕上|しあ}げた→仕上げる：04664_shiageru⟧。
examples.english: The craftsmen worked away silently and finished all the orders by evening.

notes:
A taru-adjective/adverb from the repeated kanji {黙|もく} (silence). Almost always used in the adverbial form {黙々|もくもく}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {黙々|もくもく}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧ (work silently)
- {黙々|もくもく}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧ (eat in silence)
- {黙々|もくもく}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧ (walk silently)
- {黙々|もくもく}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (work on a task silently)

USAGE:
Carries a positive connotation of diligence and quiet determination. Describes someone who gets things done without fuss or complaint. The ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ particle is required when using it adverbially. Often used to praise someone's work ethic or describe an admirable quality.
